conclusion: The existing 95 questions and their substantive expected answers are supported. I cannot certify complete in-scope procedural coverage: the initial House Hagal deck preparation is not actually requested by any question. One narrow addition is proposed; no other addition survived independent novelty review.
scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12; standard 2-4-player multiplayer including scoring two-player Rival; optional standard CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; ten contrasting-back Ix contracts identified only as excluded compatibility components. No solo, optional Rival variants, teams, cross-game expansions or later-product components.

independence_statement.basis: Complete final questions and final key were read first, then each supplied authoritative text completely, followed by source-only visual checks. Coverage judgments use what questions ask, not incidental key content. No prior audit or reader outcome influenced the findings.

nonmaterial_notes.note: The key identifies the two decision variables and directs use of each printed card condition. The supplement text itself does not enumerate both complete card faces; no unsupported numeric destination rule was invented.

genuine_additions.question: Before the first round of standard two-player play, how do you prepare the House Hagal deck and where do you put it? Is its 2P Reshuffle card removed?
genuine_additions.answer: Shuffle the House Hagal deck and place it near the shared Rival. Keep the card marked 2P Reshuffle in that deck; removing it is a solo-game instruction.
genuine_additions.new_rule: Initial randomization and placement of the automation deck before its first draw.
genuine_additions.novelty: Q20 asks only what happens after the House Hagal deck is empty or Reshuffle is drawn. Q60 asks starting Rival personal components/resources and what happens to the 2P Reshuffle card, not preparation of the shared deck. Q84 explicitly enumerates human starter, Intrigue, Imperium/Row and Reserve setup and does not include House Hagal. None of the remaining complete-bank questions requests the initial House Hagal shuffle. This is a source-prescribed initial state for the distinct automation mechanism, not a changed destination/resource/number in an existing visit or reward branch. The retained 2P card is repeated here only to make the setup answer complete, and is not claimed as new coverage.
